detail.command: set +e; echo '===STATUS==='; git status --short; echo '===HEAD==='; git log --oneline -3; echo '===MODE_FILES==='; ls -l src/camera/CameraModeController.ts src/camera/CameraModeController.test.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '===SAVED_VERIFY_SUMMARIES==='; for f in /tmp/c-tc.log /tmp/c-cam.log /tmp/c-ui.log /tmp/c-in.log /tmp/c-bd.log; do echo "--- $f ---"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |FAIL|error|built in|✓ built|TS[0-9]{4}' "$f" | tail -8; else echo MISSING; fi; done
